title: Thai Kimchi Crunchie Bake
description: A spicy, savory, and crunchy Thai-inspired dish featuring kimchi, crunchy topping, and melted cheese.
instructions: In an 8x8 inch baking dish, spread kimchi evenly.
Sprinkle Crunchie on top of the cheese.
Bake for 15-20 minutes or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove from oven and let cool for a few minutes.
Optional: Add some heat by sprinkling red pepper flakes on top before baking.
